about: A claim states a state, never an action: folding the same state twice is folding it once, and an origin that
says the same thing again is still one origin. Anything whose second application differs from its first is not a state.

cases.name: a state folded twice is folded once
repeating a state inside a fold changes nothing
the same origin saying it again is one origin

coverage.criterion: a state folded twice, a state repeated inside a fold, and one origin repeating itself
